experiments.scope: Selected target sha256-r31-prefix-v1. Phase 3 (completion) of proof.md only, run on the published first block M0 and published second-block words W0..W12. For each organizer seed the program draws fresh search offsets r13_j and r15_j for every (g, w14) candidate and stops once the global budget GLOBAL_PHASE3_CAP = 2^16 of Phase-3 attempts (outer x-evaluations) is spent, so it executes exactly the capped randomized completion the proof declares (proof.md Section 9; caps CAP13 = 2^18, CAP15 = 2^12, GLOBAL_PHASE3_CAP = 2^16). Phases 1 and 2 (table build and first-block matching) are not executed.
experiments.hypothesis: Within the proof-declared global tested-value budget, the fresh-offset completion search finds (W13, W14, W15) for the published prefix and returns two distinct 128-byte messages with equal 31-step SHA-256 digests.
